ns2:course.label: Metaphysics
ns2:course.description: Investigation of various metaphysical issues concerning, for example, existence, substance, particulars and universals, and space and time. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: One course in philosophy.
